_comment: Known cross-edition versification shifts: an EN (KJV/NIV) chapter:verse address that legitimately lands at a DIFFERENT chapter:verse in another language's Bible edition, because that edition splits chapters/verses differently at this point. Each entry means: when validate_translated_pair() can't find the EN-resolved address in the target DB, it retries at (target_chapter, target_verse_start-target_verse_end) instead before reporting a warning. target_* fields are the actual lookup key; native_reference/verified are human-readable documentation only, not used by the code. Add an entry ONLY after confirming the shift directly against the target DB — never to silence an unrelated or unverified failure.

exceptions.verified: JCB merges KJV's verses 15-16 into a single verse 15 (dynamic-equivalence translation); confirmed verse 15 text covers both 'curses his God shall bear his sin' and 'blasphemes the name of the LORD...shall surely be put to death' — chapter has only 23 verses total vs KJV's 23 (13-14 and 15-16 each merged into one).
LSG1910 chapter 1 ends at verse 16; confirmed text at chapter 2 verse 1 matches KJV Jonah 1:17 verbatim (great fish swallows Jonah).
LU17 confirmed text at chapter 2 verse 1 matches KJV Jonah 1:17 verbatim (great fish swallows Jonah); text cross-checked against saulo_de_001.json's own stored 'Jona 2:1' reference.
LU17 confirmed text at chapter 3 verse 1 matches KJV Joel 2:28 (Spirit poured out on all flesh); cross-checked against ascension_victory_de_001.json's own stored 'Joel 3:1' reference.

LU17 confirmed text at chapter 3 verse 23 matches KJV Malachi 4:5 (sending Elijah before the day of the LORD); cross-checked against jordan_convergence_de_001.json's own stored 'Der Prophet Maleachi 3:23' reference.

LSG1910 shifts Psalm 18 by one verse starting partway through the chapter; confirmed text at 18:17 ('Il étendit sa main d'en haut, il me saisit, Il me retira des grandes eaux') matches KJV Psalm 18:16 verbatim (God reaches down and draws the psalmist out of many waters).

LU17 shifts Psalm 18 by one verse starting partway through the chapter; confirmed text at 18:17 ('Er streckte seine Hand aus von der Höhe und fasste mich und zog mich aus großen Wassern') matches KJV Psalm 18:16 verbatim (God reaches down and draws the psalmist out of many waters).

LSG1910 shifts Psalm 41 by one verse (verse 1 is the psalm superscription, counted separately from KJV's unnumbered title); confirmed text at 41:10 ('Celui-là même avec qui j'étais en paix, Qui avait ma confiance et qui mangeait mon pain, Lève le talon contre moi.') matches KJV Psalm 41:9 verbatim (familiar friend who ate my bread lifted up his heel against me).

LU17 shifts Psalm 41 by one verse (verse 1 is the psalm superscription, counted separately from KJV's unnumbered title); confirmed text at 41:10 ('Auch mein Freund, dem ich vertraute, der mein Brot aß, tritt mich mit Füßen.') matches KJV Psalm 41:9 verbatim (familiar friend who ate my bread lifted up his heel against me).

MBB05's verse 37 alone ends mid-sentence ('...lumapit sa akin,') and only completes the thought ('...ay uminom.') in verse 38 — a genuine sentence-boundary split not present in KJV, where verse 37 alone is a complete sentence ('If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink'). Confirmed against woman_well_fil_001.json cards[3].scripture_connections[2].

CUV1919's verse 9 alone ends mid-quote ('...因为他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。', with the direct-speech 「 never closed) and only closes the quotation ('...失丧的人。」') in verse 10 — a genuine sentence-boundary split not present in KJV, where verse 9 alone is a complete sentence ('This day is salvation come to this house'). Confirmed against zacchaeus_zh_001.json cards[6]/cards[10] verse_overlay.
